definitions.explanation: Spun sugar wound onto a stick, a standard food at festival stalls and fairs.

examples.japanese: {綿飴|わたあめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦お{祭|まつ}り→お祭り：01349_omatsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{綿飴|わたあめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate cotton candy at a festival stall.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ、{綿飴|わたあめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ふわふわ→ふわふわ：05156_fuwafuwa⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だった。
examples.english: As a child I loved watching cotton candy grow fluffy and big inside the machine.

notes:
Usually written わたあめ. At festivals it is sold in plastic bags printed with anime characters.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {綿菓子|わたがし}: the same thing; the more usual name in western Japan
- ⟦{飴|あめ}→飴：00687_ame⟧: candy in general
